attr.title: Evil Egg
attr.desc: Evil Egg was an ecstatic twin-stick nightmare known for its brutal shooting action and intense audiovisual effects. Infinite horrors tear apart a world of little green men, the only hope an errant hatchling.
attr.inst: Download v1.4.8 of the game and place Evil Egg.exe in ports/evilegg/
attr.inst_md:
Download v1.48 of the game from [ivysly.com](https://ivysly.com/static/games/EvilEgg/versions/Evil%20Egg_windows_nodrm_1.4.8.zip) or via Steam using Steam console and the following steam command `download_depot 3651950 3651951 1239020414633141241`
Place Evil Egg.exe in ports/evilegg/
